title: Says a parcel is stuck or illegal
why: Fake courier messages say a parcel is held and send you to a link that collects card details or a fee. Others claim it has drugs in it to start a 'digital arrest'.
examples: Your parcel is on hold at customs. Pay Rs 49 redelivery fee: http://dhl-in.top/pay
FedEx: a package in your name has been seized as it contains illegal items.
safe: Your Amazon package will be delivered today between 2 pm and 6 pm.
Your courier from Delhivery has been delivered.
